about: Style QA (art-pipeline.md): limits per class on each texture as the game shows it (mask stats x the runtime strength in rockDetail.ts SURFACE_TEX; colour tiles: linear luminance). std = spread around the mean; blotch = the same after a blur over 1/32 of the tile (per-unit value changes and mottling, which read as dirt). Calibrated on the owner-approved wood and shingle (detail) and the lawn tiles (ground); paving sits below the concept art's pale flagstones (std 0.26 there, lighting included). Read by scripts/gen-textures.py qa and tests/unit/textures.test.ts.
